qualifier: translational control and ATF6/CREB3 chaperone induction
name: ER unfolded protein response and stress translational control
rationale: All members concern the ER-stress UPR (ATF6, IRE1/XBP1, PERK/ATF4, CREB3 arms, stress-induced translational control and ER-stress beta-cell/intrinsic apoptosis), and unlike the confusables it has the ATF6/CREB3 chaperone arms and translation control rather than mitochondrial/HRI/GCN2 stress or IRE1 negative regulation.

name: Short-chain acyl-CoA, carnitine and choline metabolism
rationale: Members are small mitochondrial/peroxisomal catabolic routes yielding or handling short/medium acyl-CoAs (threonine, isoleucine, malonyl-, succinyl-, pristanoyl-CoA) together with carnitine synthesis and choline catabolism, which the alpha-oxidation, organic-acid and gluconeogenic confusables lack.

name: IL-12-driven Th1 and CD4+ T cell differentiation
rationale: Members describe CD4+ T cell fate programs centred on IL-12/STAT-driven Th1 differentiation (plus Treg and memory differentiation), whereas confusables emphasise dendritic-cell IL-12 or IFN-gamma production and signalling.

qualifier: late endosome, MVB and autophagosome fusion
name: Lysosomal fusion of late endosomes and autophagosomes
rationale: All four members are terminal fusion of late endosomes, MVBs, autophagosomes or vacuoles with lysosomes, distinct from confusables on Golgi-lysosome vesicle biogenesis or autophagosome assembly.

name: Cullin-RING ligase neddylation and substrate ubiquitination
rationale: Members cover neddylation/deneddylation and COP9 signalosome control of cullin-RING ligases and their substrate degradation (PD-L1, NRF2, DVL, AURKA, NOTCH4) with K11/branched chains, which the RHOBTB/protein-stability confusables lack.

name: Adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis and congenital enzyme deficiencies
rationale: All members concern pregnenolone-to-gluco/mineralocorticoid synthesis by CYP11A1/17A1/21A2/11B1/11B2 (and their defects, ferredoxin electron supply), unlike confusables centred on androgen/estrogen synthesis or aldosterone secretion regulation.

qualifier: iron, heme, copper and cadmium rather than zinc
name: Iron, heme, copper and heavy-metal transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are transport, homeostasis and detoxification of iron/heme/transferrin, copper, cadmium, manganese and cobalt, distinguished from confusables dominated by zinc handling or HMOX1/BACH1 metal responses.

name: Cardiac contractility regulation by sarcoplasmic calcium handling
rationale: Members regulate cardiac force, relaxation and membrane potential via calcium sequestration and release, whereas confusables emphasise heart rate, Na/Ca exchange or ryanodine-channel regulation.

qualifier: tolerance, Treg differentiation and activation-induced death
name: T cell activation control: tolerance, Treg differentiation, activation-induced death
rationale: Members restrain or steer T cell activation (suppressed proliferation and cytokines, Treg and Th1 differentiation, tolerance, AICD/Fas, allograft rejection), and unlike confusables include T cell signalling modules and AICD rather than NK/DC cytotoxicity or anergy.

name: Golgi N- and O-glycan processing and terminal epitope synthesis
rationale: Members build and cap protein glycans (N-glycan trimming/branching, GalNAc O-glycosylation, sialylation, fucosylation, ABO/Lewis antigens, selectin ligands), whereas confusables cover nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis and transport.

qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 sensing and host restriction of viral life cycle
name: RIG-I/MDA5 type I interferon induction and host viral restriction
rationale: Members span RLR sensing, TBK1/TRAF-IRF3/7 type I IFN induction, ISG15 and host suppression of viral replication and release, which distinguishes it from confusables centred on endosomal TLRs, cGAS/STING, IFN-gamma or chemokine output.

qualifier: opsin light absorption and cascade, not retinoid cycle
name: Photoreceptor phototransduction cascade and opsin defects
rationale: Members are opsin light absorption, phototransduction activation/recovery and cone-opsin or SLC24A1 defects, distinct from confusables on the retinoid cycle or photoreceptor development.

name: TAK1-mediated NF-kB and JNK/p38 activation downstream of TLRs
rationale: Members follow IRAK/TRAF6/TRIF-RIP1 signals to TAK1 and IKK, activating canonical NF-kB and JNK/p38 stress kinases, which separates it from confusables on non-canonical NF-kB, TNFR1 or TBK1-IRF3 signalling.

name: Endothelial eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2-driven vascular permeability
rationale: All three members concern endothelial eNOS localization and VEGFR2-eNOS permeability signalling, unlike confusables on NO-cGMP signalling or vascular smooth muscle tone.

qualifier: non-oxidative pentose phosphate and glucuronate-xylulose route, with inborn errors
name: Galactose and pentose-xylulose metabolism, including inborn errors
rationale: Members cover Leloir galactose catabolism, non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism with their enzyme deficiencies, whereas confusables concern fructose and alditol metabolism.

qualifier: processing/turnover control and target-specific translational repression
name: Regulation of miRNA processing, turnover and target-specific translation
rationale: Members regulate pri/pre-miRNA processing and miRNA decay and miRNA control of specific mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1), unlike confusables on core biogenesis, RISC silencing or deadenylation.

name: Purine nucleotide de novo synthesis and salvage
rationale: Members are PRPP synthesis, de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis and HPRT/APRT purine salvage, distinct from confusables on purine catabolism, deoxypurines or pyrimidine synthesis.

name: Intramembrane proteolytic release of NOTCH2-4 and ERBB4 intracellular domains
rationale: Members concern cleavage-driven release and nuclear signalling or downregulation of NOTCH2/3/4 and ERBB4 intracellular domains, whereas confusables centre on NOTCH1 and Notch target transcription.

qualifier: all five taste modalities, plus smell
name: Taste perception across five modalities, with smell
rationale: Members cover sweet, bitter, umami, sour and salty taste perception (with class C taste GPCRs) plus odorant perception, distinguishing it from confusables centred on olfactory receptors, pheromones or acid-sensing channels.

name: TBK1/IKKe-IRF3-driven interferon-beta production and its regulation
rationale: Members regulate nucleic-acid-sensor to TBK1/IKKe-IRF3 induction of IFN-alpha/beta (RIG-I, MDA5, cGAS/STING, TLR3), which confusables lack in favour of broader antiviral effector or NF-kB outputs.

qualifier: presynaptic choline reuptake and ACh release
name: Presynaptic cholinergic transmission and choline reuptake
rationale: Members concern acetylcholine synthesis, secretion and neuromuscular transmission with SLC5A7 choline transport and its HMN7A defects, unlike confusables on postsynaptic nicotinic receptors, NMJ assembly or other SLC transporters.

qualifier: agglutination and direct cytolysis of microbes
name: Mucosal antibacterial agglutination and microbe cytolysis
rationale: All three members describe innate mucosal defense that agglutinates and lyses microbes, distinct from confusables on defensins, neutrophil killing, respiratory burst or metal sequestration.

qualifier: kinesin/Miro motor transport and ER tubule shaping
name: Kinesin-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members are motor-based transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors along axons/dendrites plus ER tubular network formation, which confusables lack in favour of microtubule severing, tubulin modification or ER contact-site lipid transfer.

name: Sarcomere assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members are myofilament assembly, actin-myosin sliding and striated contraction in differentiating fibres, distinct from confusables on myoblast commitment, regeneration or neuromuscular junction formation.

name: Mitochondrial protease protein processing and uniporter calcium regulation
rationale: Members are mitochondrial presequence processing and protein catabolism plus SMDT1/MCU calcium uptake regulation, unlike confusables on protein import, cristae formation or respiratory chain assembly.
